video_url.title: Video
video_url.description: Video to add sound to: an HTTP(S) URL or a base64 data URI, up to 8 MB.

text_prompt.title: Text Prompt
text_prompt.description: Guides the soundtrack; name off-screen sounds or ambience not shown in the picture.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Sounds to exclude, as a short comma-separated list.

preserve_speech.title: Preserve Speech
preserve_speech.description: Keep input speech and generate the rest around it; false yields sound effects only and suppresses speech.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Seconds of sound, clamped to the video length; >10s generates in 10s windows.

num_samples.title: Num Samples
num_samples.description: Number of variations; billed per sample.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Generation seed; -1 or null for random.
